description: React component for the application's footer, managing UI elements like account menu, sync status, updates, and navigation controls.

classes.name: Footer
classes.description: React component managing the footer UI, including account menu, sync status, updates, and navigation controls.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and properties when component is unmounted.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes event observers and state synchronization after component mounts.

methods.name: reloadUpgradeStatus
methods.description: Checks for security updates and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when app launches, such as reloading user info and status.

methods.name: reloadUser
methods.description: Reloads current user information.

methods.name: reloadPasscodeStatus
methods.description: Checks if passcode is set and updates state.

methods.name: onAppKeyChange
methods.description: Handles changes in app key, reloading passcode status.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Handles various application events to update UI and status.

methods.name: updateSyncStatus
methods.description: Updates sync status message based on current sync progress or errors.

methods.name: updateLocalDataStatus
methods.description: Updates status message related to local data loading or decryption.

methods.name: updateOfflineStatus
methods.description: Updates offline status in the component state.

methods.name: findErrors
methods.description: Checks for sync errors and updates error state.

methods.name: securityUpdateClickHandler
methods.description: Handles user confirmation and initiates security protocol upgrade.

methods.name: accountMenuClickHandler
methods.description: Toggles account menu visibility.

methods.name: quickSettingsClickHandler
methods.description: Toggles quick settings menu.

methods.name: syncResolutionClickHandler
methods.description: Toggles sync resolution menu.

methods.name: closeAccountMenu
methods.description: Closes the account menu and resets its pane.

methods.name: lockClickHandler
methods.description: Locks the application.

methods.name: onNewUpdateAvailable
methods.description: Sets state to show new update notification.

methods.name: newUpdateClickHandler
methods.description: Handles user clicking on new update notification.

methods.name: betaMessageClickHandler
methods.description: Displays alert about beta version usage.

methods.name: clickOutsideAccountMenu
methods.description: Closes account menu when clicking outside.

methods.name: clickOutsideQuickSettingsMenu
methods.description: Closes quick settings menu when clicking outside.

methods.name: openPreferences
methods.description: Opens preferences pane, optionally opening 'what's new'.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the footer component with UI elements and controls.
